newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV mobile phone unit to invest $116 mln in '97.
newsitem.headline: CANTV mobile phone unit to invest $116 mln in '97.

text.p: Cellular telephone company Movilnet, a unit of Venezuelan telephone company CANTV, said it plans to invest $116 million in 1997.
Movilnet did not give a comparative investment figure for 1996.
"One of the aims of this year is to expand national coverage with an aggressive plan which contemplates as a priority, the west of the country," Movilnet said in a release.
CANTV President Gustavo Roosen said Wednesday 1997 would see important customer growth for Movilnet, which grew 26 percent in 1996 to 214,000 users.
